item.title: Watch: Linkin Park Drops "Over Each Other" Video as Controversy Looms Large
item.description: The clock is ticking. Linkin Park’s upcoming album, From Zero, is just weeks away from hitting shelves. It’s their first full-length release since 2017’s One More Light and their first step forward following Chester Bennington’s death.
